uart.signal: the committed RV32EC+Zmmul fixture ELF (examples/ch32v006k8u6/uart_hello.c) clocks USART1 from PB2PCENR bit 14, maps TX to PD5, checks a MUL result and writes 'Hello from CH32V006\r\n' through DATAR (0x40013804); the test asserts the console sink receives exactly that string, and a negative control with the clock gate moved to an unset bit asserts the sink stays empty. Polled TX only: no PFIC, so USART1_IRQn is not wired
uart.lane: pr-workspace-tests shards - cargo test -p labwired-core --test vendor ch32v006_compiled_firmware::

spi.gap: SPI1 (0x40013000) is not modelled; it is not in the ch32v006k8u6 descriptor's peripherals list.
